ModMetaData.name: GeneFoundry
ModMetaData.author: Guy Symonds
ModMetaData.description:
Turn organic matter into genetic possibilities.
GeneFoundry adds a three-stage biotechnology chain: extract raw biomass from meat, plants or organic corpses at the Gene Vat; refine it using hopper-fed, processor-assisted machinery; then manufacture selected single- or multi-gene genepacks at the Gene Fabricator.
Features weighted operator skills, corpse stripping and artificial-part salvage, enzymatic extraction, rot-stink incidents, batch failure influenced by skill and room conditions, and a dedicated gene research tree generated from loaded gene categories. Raw extraction guarantees some recovery; failed refinery batches lose their ingredients.
Requires RimWorld 1.6 and Biotech. No Harmony dependency. Other game versions and mod combinations are not declared supported.
